def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min(x for r in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[r][x] == c))
    tiles = []
    for c in colors:
        pts = [(r, x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[r][x] == c]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,x in pts), max(r for r,x in pts)
        x0, x1 = min(x for r,x in pts), max(x for r,x in pts)
        tiles.append([[grid[r][x] if grid[r][x] == c else 0 for x in range(x0,x1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)])
    oh = max(map(len, tiles))
    out = [[0 for _ in range(sum(len(t[0]) for t in tiles))] for _ in range(oh)]
    xoff = 0
    for t in tiles:
        for r in range(len(t)):
            out[r][xoff:xoff+len(t[r])] = t[r]
        xoff += len(t[0])
    return out
